t: The Adda mono mixer kitchen tap in chrome offers a reliable and stylish solution for modern kitchen installations. Featuring durable zinc construction and a smooth side lever operation for precise temperature and flow control, with a 35mm ceramic cartridge to ensure consistent performance and longevity. The deck mounted design with a swivel spout provides flexibility and ease of use for various kitchen tasks. Equipped with a replaceable Neoperl water-saving aerator and an anti-limescale spout.
